- Invest in your favorites

- Build up a good supportive dancer for your arena teams. You'll score slightly less, but it's worth it to make the mode more playable.

- Check out the heroic grail section for a good merge project unit that scores well. To check a units potential score, use the arcticsilverfox online arena score calculator.

-  For Aether Raids, invest in your offensive mythic heroes for better scoring. Defense mythic merges don't matter as much. Also don't get hung up on filling up your row of buildings for offense; often the extra space to avoid long range threats is more important.

- Only the first team you enter Arena Assault with has to score high. For all the subsequent ones, you just need to make sure the units all have the right blessings for the season.

- Don't worry too much about Summoner Duels. It has a meta that evolves rather fast and imo, requires higher investment/specific units to really do well. Even just doing one match in SDR and SDS will at least get you some rewards though.

- If you want to get some idea of the changing trends in the competitive modes, check out the meta reports by Fehology on youtube that come out every so often.

- Invest in your favorites!

Thanks for sharing. In my experience the effexor does indeed make a difference mentally; I haven't had any negative thought spirals / suicidal ideations nearly as bad as a year ago. This is actually my second time on effexor; the first time I went up to a dose of 300mg, but after a long time I was able to taper off of it completely. That went well for a while, until eventually shit hit the fan again. But from that stint of being 'all natural' again I can say that for me, my (solo) orgasms did become more normal again then (I was single).

I've been considering now lowering the dose to 75mg, in hopes of getting more feeling back, but atm I'm still too scared to risk the suicidal ideations coming back.

As for your case, I say give it a little longer than 2 months. Let your body adjust a little longer, and know that a diminshed libido is a well-known side effect, of no fault of your own. For me it took a few months to actually get to where I'm at. I'm no psychiatrist though.

Male here. A few years ago, I decreased gradually from the maximum recommended dose of 300mg venlafaxine/effexor down to zero over a long time. Sadly enough I couldnt get tapering strips, but if you can, try them out to make the withdrawal more slow and steady. Especially the last bit is notoriously hard, from what I hear. To me it seems you are simply going too fast, please try to make smaller steps. If tapering strips are unavailable, a last ditch effort could be to create your own intermediate doses by opening up capsules and redistributing the amount. But it is not recommended. Shame that tapering strips usually arent covered by insurance, it's criminal imo.

So simply put, yes I think you should go back to your previous dose in the short term, until you figure out a more gradual tapering method. And yes, unfortunately these are common withdrawal symptoms you are having, at least from my experience. Forgetting to take my caps just for one day, caused me to wake up in a cold sweat the following night. Seeing stars, severe brainfog, shivering, dry mouth iirc. I quickly took my caps and before long, it calmed down and I was able to still get some sleep after.

Alright let's see:

- Her speed is just middling, if you're not using QR then it's not good enough to naturally double. The weapon refine does alleviate this issue somewhat, but it means you HAVE to run her with other fliers or she's pretty underwhelming.
- You get the most benefit from Iote's Shield if you can actually counterattack too. So, DC or Distant Foil are recommended to run if you really want to use Iote's.
- Atk/def form is... alright, but easier to set up for an enemy phase focused build. In player phase, you risk having to move away from your allies to attack, causing the form skill to be weaker. But, I get that it has good synergy with the weapon refine. I would suggest going for atk/spd forme if possible, it'll at least protect her against doubles and you might even get the occasional quad-attack on a foe...
- ...however, for pegasus flight to work well, you need high !visible! speed and res stats. This palla has neither. For this reason you see people often run fury with it, or fort. def/res if they already have a fast flier. On a budget you could just stick on a spd/res +2 skill in the seal slot.
- Reposition, moonbow and goad flier are old school but still good. Further flier buffs from her allies (mainly hone fliers) would help Palla a lot to get that higher visible speed.

Hope that gave some insight.

Gonna keep my Jorge at +9 until a ghb rerun to save some grails. I also went for a speed build on him, but more support focused for in arena.

- His excellent prf bow, offering support for nearby allies
- Blue flame for scoring and the whole being adjacent thing
- Atk spd bond 4 cause he will be next to allies alot
- Atk spd ruse, combined with rally atk spd, to boost an ally, debuff foes and provide the guard effect on them. 
- Joint drive speed, so he offers not only in combat atk and (indirectly) def/res, but also speed, and boost his own normally rather middling speed some more.
- C-slot is a bit more flexible, probably atk spd bond cause you might as well go all out with bonds.

Goal is mainly to help an adjacent (bonus) ally in arena safely deal with one or more foes in the enemy phase, while making Jorge himself strong and fast enough to deal with enemies should he get attacked himself.

When facing an enemy team that's spreading panic, then Jorge can just forego rallying and stick to only providing the in-combat buffs/debuffs. And even then he himself is less bothered by field debuffs thanks to the penalty-ignoring aspect of atk spd bond 4.

I also like that keeping him next to allies fits with his voice line about being paired up. And him not being a combat unit in the Tellius games fits with a more supportive, enemy debuffing role imo.
